scope: P3 server enforcement of shared-server friend requests
issue: Friend request eligibility loaded friend-request preferences, then separately reloaded DM defaults/overrides. Concurrent changes could combine criteria from different revisions and allow a request that neither complete revision allowed.
change: Parse server-DM rules from the already-loaded preference snapshot; existing DM creation path reuses the same parser.
regression: TestFriendRequestPolicy_UsesOnePreferenceSnapshot switches between two individually denying snapshots; assert request denied and repository read exactly once.
verification: Linux Go service tests matching TestFriendRequestPolicy|TestServerDMPolicy passed with -count=1; complete go test ./services passed in 20.976s; gofmt applied
limitations: Does not claim transaction-wide serializability for independent membership/friendship changes or real multi-client acceptance. No migration or production write.
